1.q: How long does a typical project take?
1.a: Most websites are delivered within 1–2 weeks. AI agents take 1–3 weeks depending on complexity and training data. Automations vary based on the number of integrations — we'll give you a timeline after the discovery call.

2.q: Do you work with clients outside Kuwait?
2.a: Absolutely. While we're based in Kuwait, we work with businesses across the Gulf and internationally. Everything is managed remotely with regular video check-ins.

3.q: What languages do your AI agents support?
3.a: Our agents support English and Arabic out of the box, including Kuwaiti dialect. Additional languages can be added based on your needs.

4.q: What happens after my project is delivered?
4.a: We provide ongoing maintenance and support. For websites, this includes hosting and updates. For AI agents, your subscription covers continuous training, monitoring, and improvements.

5.q: Can I try the AI agent before committing?
5.a: Yes! Check out our live demo to see how an AI agent works. We also offer a free consultation where we can discuss your specific use case and show you what's possible.

6.q: Do you offer custom pricing for larger projects?
6.a: Yes. Our listed prices are starting points — we tailor pricing based on scope, complexity, and ongoing needs. Book a free consultation and we'll provide an accurate quote.

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: CODET was founded with a simple belief: every business deserves access to modern digital tools. We saw companies struggling with outdated processes, manual workflows, and generic websites that didn't convert.
story.p2: So we built a team that bridges the gap between business needs and technical solutions — delivering websites, AI agents, and automations that actually move the needle.

1.title: Results First
1.description: We measure success by your ROI, not by lines of code. Every project starts with your business goals.

2.title: Built to Last
2.description: Clean architecture, modern frameworks, and scalable infrastructure — so your investment keeps paying off.

3.title: Transparent Process
3.description: No black boxes. You'll always know what we're building, why, and what's next.

4.title: Continuous Support
4.description: We don't disappear after launch. Ongoing maintenance, updates, and optimization are part of the deal.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: CODET ("we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website codet-kw.com.
privacy.section1Text: We collect only the information you voluntarily provide through our contact form: your name, email address, service interest, and message. We also use Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights, which collect anonymous, aggregated usage data (page views, performance metrics). No cookies are used for tracking. The only cookie stored is your cookie consent preference.
privacy.section2Text: We use the information you provide through our contact form solely to respond to your inquiry and discuss potential services. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with any third parties.
privacy.section3Text: We use the following services to operate our website:
privacy.service1: Resend — to deliver contact form emails
privacy.service2: Vercel — for website hosting and anonymous analytics
privacy.service3: Google Fonts — for web font delivery
privacy.section4Text: Contact form submissions are retained only as long as necessary to respond to your inquiry. You may request deletion of your data at any time by emailing us at codet.kuwait@gmail.com.
privacy.section5Text: You have the right to access, correct, or delete any personal data we hold about you. To exercise these rights, contact us at codet.kuwait@gmail.com.
privacy.section6Text: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.
privacy.section7Text: For questions about this privacy policy, email us at codet.kuwait@gmail.com.
